text:
Maya: Quick sync 0 finalizing social execution for next week's launch + companion webinar. Need final X + LinkedIn copy, hero image variants, engagement follow-up owner, and HubSpot routing. We're A/Bing short vs long X threads.

Jess: I'll draft copy today. Plan: LinkedIn longform, X short pulse + thread, one benchmark-led thread with CTA to webinar.

Sam: Routing checklist: HubSpot form, Zap to tag leads as 'social_launch_q2', assign to SDR queue. I can build Zap if I get form URL + UTMs.

Lina: Engagement follow-ups proposal:
- Wave 1: auto DM/comment reply w/ webinar link (within 24h)
- Wave 2: SDR outreach for hot leads (score >=60)
I'll draft templates once copy is locked.

Maya: Proposed posting windows (confirm pls):
```schedule
X:
- Mon 09:00 PT - short pulse (anchor)
- Mon 09:10 PT - thread explainer (5 tweets)
LinkedIn:
- Tue 10:00 PT - longform + image
- Thu 14:00 PT - reminder (short)
```
Aim to capture both coasts.

Oliver: Asset specs needed:
- Hero 1200x628 (primary)
- Square 1080x1080 for repurpose
- LinkedIn header 1200x627
- PNG + PSD source
Can design supply 3 color variants? Forwarding to DesignOps.

Jess: I'll produce two headline variants (short/long) + three LinkedIn captions. Uploading to content drive: https://drive.google.com/placeholder/RedwoodSocial/launch_assets

Sam: UTM template for analytics:
- utm_source=x (or linkedin)
- utm_medium=social
- utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2
Example: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2

Lina: Draft follow-ups:
- Auto DM (short): "Thanks for the reaction 0 here's the webinar sign-up: <link>"
- Comment reply: "Love that you flagged benchmarking 0 quick demo in the webinar: <link>"
I'll post templates here for sign-off.

Maya: Benchmark line for thread 0 keep quantitative/visual. Draft: "Cut inference cost by 3x in latency-sensitive workloads 0 see how in our webinar." Thoughts?

Sam: Slight tweak: "3x cost reduction at 90th pct latency SLA 0 details in the webinar." More credibility for infra audience.

Jess: Paid amp note 0 who will tag posts for paid submission? Need final copy + hero by EOD Wed to submit.

Oliver: I'll handle paid submission once assets land. @DesignOps please deliver Tue EOD.

postbot: reminder - uploaded assets are scanned for size & format. Failures will tag @Oliver.

Maya: Owners & deadlines:
- Jess: final copy variants (due today EOD)
- DesignOps: images (due Tue EOD)
- Sam: HubSpot form + Zap (draft Wed AM)
- Lina: follow-up templates (draft Wed)
- Oliver: paid submission & checklist

Jess: Copies uploaded to drafts folder (link above). I'll add alt text.

Lina: I'll drop the comment + DM scripts here for review.

Sam: Will create a test Zap and share steps. Want a dry run before go-live.

Maya: One more item 0 should we pin a canonical X thread with webinar link + benchmark snapshot? That can be source for replies/DMs.

Oliver: Yes, pin canonical thread and use that thread ID for all replies.

postbot: scheduled-drafts created in Buffer (ids: buf_99721, buf_99722) - drafts only.

Jess: Final note - include alt text + accessibility checklist before paid submit.

DesignOps: Confirmed 0 assets on track Tue EOD with PSD + export variants.

Maya: Anything blocking paid submission or copy? If not, we proceed.

Oliver: No blockers from paid.

Maya: Great. Close this thread once final copies + asset links are live. Thanks team :rocket:
